places-abrigo-de-la-fuente-de-montanoz-i.story: From Nerpio it runs 164 km to Nerpio; allow about 2 h 50 of riding. The stops in between: Diosa madre, Abrigo del Sabinar, Benizar V and back through Abrigo del Sabinar. The highest point is about 1,400 m. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.

scenicChapters.title: Iglesia de Santa María → Restos mudéjares de palacio de la Aljaferí
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 74 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-iglesia-de-santa-maria-forau-del-.story: 305 km from Tobed to Tobed, about 5 h 16 of riding. It goes by way of Restos mudéjares de palacio de la Aljaferí, Forau del Cocho and back through Restos mudéjares de palacio de la Aljaferí. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
